items.label: Excellent & Efficient
items.value: Free yourself from traditional cleaning tools, the cordless electric spin scrubber will be a great kitchen/bathroom/window/housekeeping cleaning assistant. It is super lightweight and user-friendly of little noise, weighing only 2.4 pounds

items.label: Dual Speed Modes
items.value: Built with a strong motor, the electric cleaning brush enables rotation at a high speed of up to 320 RPM. It supports switching between 2 different speeds of cleaning for both daily cleaning and deep cleaning

items.label: Replaceable & Adjustable
items.value: With 8 replaceable brush heads and an adjustable handle, the electric spin scrubber is widely used in any place, such as the kitchen, bathroom, windows, corners, etc. The extension length range of the electric spin scrubber is 14 to 54 inches

items.label: Long Battery Time with LCD Display
items.value: Fast charging with the Type-C port, the electric spin scrubber can be quickly fully charged in 3 hours, lasting for up to 100 minutes of no pressure use. (The using time may be different under different cleaning pressure) The special LCD design allows you to check the battery level precisely to the percentage in real time. You do not need to worry about whether the tool is under low-battery status before use

items.label: Full Body IPX7 Waterproof
items.value: The spin scrubber is IPX7 waterproof and the full body can be soaked in water. It is ideal for cleaning kitchen, bathtubs, water jars, car wheel hubs, windows, dishes, etc

items.label: Package List
items.value: 1 Swyprrix electric spin scrubber SD-CTB01, 8 replaceable brush heads, 1 brush head storage bag, 1 wall sticker for hanging the machine, 1 cable for charging. Please be remind that the charger is not included, please prepare the charger for USB to Type-C inserting (110-220V)

items.label: A Perfect Choice of your housework
items.value: Let us throw away those traditional hand cleaning tools and have one electric spin scrubber to make housekeeping easier and simpler. Swyprrix will provide you with a 24-month after-service and help you anytime
